basics.name: Alex Morgan
basics.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer — TypeScript · React · Node.js
basics.summary: Full-stack engineer with over ten years of experience shipping SaaS products end to end — PostgreSQL schema design, typed Node.js APIs, and React front ends that stay fast under real load. I care about short feedback loops, honest tests, and readable code. Currently building the analytics query layer at Northbeam Labs.

experiences.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Built the analytics query layer (Node.js, GraphQL) serving 2M queries per day at a p95 latency under 200 ms.
Led the customer dashboard migration to Next.js: 38% faster first contentful paint and a shared SSR component library.
Designed the multi-tenant PostgreSQL schema backing 400+ enterprise accounts — zero cross-tenant incidents in over four years.
Introduced contract tests (Pact) between the front end and 12 backend services, halving integration regressions.
Mentored three junior engineers; two were promoted within 18 months.

experiences.title: Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Built fleet telemetry ingestion on AWS (API Gateway, Lambda, PostgreSQL) peaking at 5,000 vehicle events per second.
Codified the full stack in Terraform: environment provisioning dropped from two days to 20 minutes.
Shipped the driver companion back end (auth, offline sync) used daily by 8,000 drivers.
Cut the monthly AWS bill by 22% by moving batch workloads to spot instances.

experiences.title: Software Developer
bullets: Developed billing and invoicing modules for a B2B ERP (Node.js, PostgreSQL) used by 60+ SME customers.
Raised unit-test coverage of the billing core from 12% to 78% with Jest.
Automated release packaging, cutting release-day effort from six hours to 30 minutes.
Ran the second-line support rotation and documented 40+ runbooks still in use.

projects.name: RouteHawk
projects.description: Open-source command-line tool that estimates delivery-route costs and emissions from UK postcodes (TypeScript).
bullets: 850 GitHub stars and roughly 30,000 npm downloads per month.
Adopted by three regional courier startups for quote estimation.

projects.name: Design tokens pipeline
projects.description: Automated design-token pipeline (Figma to npm package) shared across Northbeam's four product teams.
bullets: Cut QA-reported UI inconsistencies by 70% within two quarters.
Tokens are consumed by both the web app and the marketing site from a single source of truth.

requirements.text: 5+ years of professional experience building backend services with TypeScript
Experience building and operating services on AWS
Experience with PCI DSS or financial compliance
Experience with GraphQL APIs at scale
Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools
